name: finem-product-planning
description: Turn a product problem into a feasible, prioritized plan and measure whether the outcome creates value.

interface.longDescription:
Turn a product problem into a feasible, prioritized plan and measure whether the outcome creates value.

Covers: Product discovery, Requirements, Feasibility, Planning/task decomposition, Product analytics/feedback.

Expected outputs: Problem statement and target users; Requirements and success measures; Feasibility assessment and implementation plan; Product feedback and experiment findings.

Original skills used through Engineering Core: gstack:office-hours, addy:idea-refine, addy:spec-driven-development, gstack:plan-eng-review, addy:constraint-driven-development, addy:planning-and-task-breakdown, superpowers:writing-plans, posthog:instrument-product-analytics, posthog:querying-posthog-data, posthog:creating-surveys.

Optional specialist and framework packs: discovery, product-validation, product-delivery, product-analytics. These are selected for the project when relevant; they are not all enabled by default.

Declared integrations: mobbin, context7, cloud-provider, posthog. These are integration recipes, not connected services; configure the corresponding tools and accounts separately.

Why the app shows one skill: this plugin exposes one entry skill which loads the relevant original specialists from Engineering Core on demand. The Skills count in the app is not the size of the shared upstream library.

Requires Engineering Core (finem-core). Tasks spanning multiple disciplines may also require the corresponding area plugins.
defaultPrompt: Inspect this project for Product & Planning and recommend the relevant original skills and framework packs.
Review Product & Planning in this project and prioritize concrete improvements with verification steps.
